interface.title: HydroPlot · Pacific Northwest
interface.stage_of_work: Data discovery, exploratory analysis and figure export for gage records
interface.what_it_is_for: Find a USGS stream gage in the Pacific Northwest, pull its live and historical discharge and stage, and run duration, percentile, rating-curve, drought, baseflow, low-flow, period/site comparison and upstream–downstream reach gain/loss analyses.

data.note: The 736-gage PNW inventory is bundled with the app. Everything else is fetched live by the server, and most of those services were reachable: USGS daily discharge and stage (Spokane 12422500 returned 4,321 daily values for 2015-01-01 to 2026-10-31, and the CSV downloaded), live current flow and seasonal percentile (2,020 cfs, 23rd percentile, Oct 31), live-flow marker colouring, and NLDI river-network navigation for reaches. Some sources failed: Climate showed ✗ for Spokane; 'No peak streamflow data available for this site' (flood frequency); 'NWM recent analysis was not available'; and the basin-boundary, flowline and dam map layers are disabled on the server ('Unavailable: install pynhd / pygeohydro'). Map base tiles did not show in the browser (grey background). So this is a mostly working instance with partial loss of climate, flood-peak, NWM and geospatial layers, not a severely degraded one.

tree.general: Characterise the flow regime of a river gauging station and how flow changes along a river
tree.specific: Pick a PNW USGS gage, inspect its discharge and stage record, run duration, drought, baseflow, rating and low-flow diagnostics, compare periods, and evaluate reach gain/loss. Coverage stops short of flood frequency (no peak data), climate linkage (Meteostat unavailable), site-to-site and multi-site comparison (Compare Sites stalled; Site Relationships and 2x2 Comparison not opened) and the Watershed page (not opened); see screens_never_reached and not_done

features.name: Interactive power-law curve fitting with auto-fit and residuals
features.general: Fit a power-law-with-offset curve to paired observations by hand with sliders, compare it to an automatic fit, score it, and view residuals coloured by group

steps: drag A, B or H0 sliders and watch the red curve and error metrics
read the hint comparing to auto-fit
press Auto-fit to restore the best fit
switch point colouring between Season and Year

features.name: Drought / baseflow / anomaly indicator panel
features.general: Compute standardised drought indices, baseflow separation with two methods, and current-year anomaly against history over a chosen lookback
features.specific: Indicators view: Years of data slider; tabs for Drought Indices (SRI-1/3/6 with D0–D4 bands and interpretation cards), Baseflow Index (rolling window slider, Lyne-Hollick vs Eckhardt agreement, separation and rolling BFI plots), Seasonal Anomaly (30-day anomaly %, percentile, status). Neither slider was moved in either run
